changes.title: Trees blob
items: Every kind of tree now grows from the same tree generator: spruces in tiered skirts, willows and weeping birches hung with curtains, banded birches, orange-barked pines, hollies with berries, yews, larches, alders and tree ferns, all a little bolder
Try ?style=bold or ?style=ref for a more pixel-art look on the trees

changes.title: Art styles
items: Try the new pixel-art looks while playing: add ?style=bold (bold flat tones with coloured outlines) or ?style=ref (the boar reference's look, with strong dark outlines), and ?px=4 or ?px=5 for bigger art pixels. Without them the game looks as it did

changes.title: Sound mix
items: A mixing pass on the sound: creatures' voices, her "ouch!", being knocked back, a soundsystem lost and a legend's charge are easier to hear over the music; home's meadow a little fuller; a relic's chime and her knockdown cry a touch softer
